title: Watch Any Creator
summary: Watch every video a YouTube creator has published, rank the rules their numbers support, have Threadify write them as a ten-post thread in your voice saved as a draft plus one post, and schedule that one post only after one exact approval.
triggers: watch every video from this creator
turn a creator's whole archive into posts

inputs.name: a YouTube creator handle, a local corpus cache or ScrapeCreators access, an optional older rules file, and a connected Threads account

outputs.name: ranked rules with evidence, then-vs-now verdicts, a ten-post thread draft, one approval card and a body-free schedule receipt

free_capabilities: local reader for a whole YouTube archive cache: long-form and Shorts listings plus transcripts
dedupe and the 20-item comparison rule from the AI Content Forensics engine, with Shorts and long-form kept apart
ranked rules from views per day, title formulas, length buckets, first-minute hooks and topics, each with evidence numbers and example video ids
then-vs-now verdicts against an older rules file: held, broke, new or untestable
thread structure check, casing guard and one approval card that stays blocked until every proof is in
paid_capability_stubs: a ScrapeCreators pull uses the owner's own ScrapeCreators account and credits, estimated and approved before any call
Threadify thread and post generation counts toward the plan's AI generations
Auto Plug replies need a plan that includes Auto Plug
scheduling uses the connected Threads account

must_show: creator watched and verified video counts
the thread saved as a draft and not scheduled
exact post text and its casing proof
exact Auto Plug text and destination, or why there is none
scheduled time with its timezone offset

instructions: Never write or reword the thread, the post or the plug; Threadify generates them and the only permitted change is lowercasing proved by the casing guard.
Show the ScrapeCreators call and credit estimate and wait for yes before any paid call; stop when charged credits pass the approved estimate.
Keep transcripts on the owner's computer; never paste or post them and quote at most twelve words.
Rank a rule only with at least 20 videos on each side inside one format family; describe smaller groups.
Without a Threadify connection, return the ranked rules and then-vs-now verdicts and say how to connect Threadify.
On HTTP 402 or a quota error, stop with a plain message.
When a schedule result is unclear, read back with get_schedule_status before any retry.

must_prove: creator, provider, observation time and verified counts
thread draft id, post count and hash, not scheduled
post and plug hashes and casing proof
